title: Describe It Basics
description: Use natural language to describe what you need and let AI find or create it

steps.title: What is Describe It?
steps.description: Describe It lets you express intent in plain English. Notention finds matching notes, creates new ones, or suggests actions.

steps.title: Open Describe It
steps.description: Press Ctrl+Shift+/ or click the Describe It button in the toolbar

steps.title: Describe Your Need
steps.description: Type: 'A meeting note template with attendees, agenda, and action items'

action.value: A meeting note template with attendees, agenda, and action items

steps.title: Submit
steps.description: Press Enter to process your description

steps.title: Review Suggestions
steps.description: Describe It will show matching templates, create a new note with the structure, or suggest relevant existing notes.

steps.title: Accept Result
steps.description: Click 'Use This' on the generated meeting note template
